text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear intro with a direct claim and preview of reasons","quality":"organization","description":"The essay presents its main idea and reasons in a more structured way, making the response easier to follow."},{"evidence":"“First of all,” “Second,” “Additionally”","quality":"transitions","description":"The essay uses explicit linking words to guide the reader through its points."},{"evidence":"“I am a self-taught artist” and “there are two main types of animation, 2D and 3D”","quality":"development of ideas","description":"The essay develops its reasons with more explanation and supporting detail rather than only listing examples."},{"evidence":"“it makes me less stressed out,” “new styles,” “future career”","quality":"task focus","description":"The essay stays more tightly centered on the prompt by consistently tying each paragraph back to the stated activity."},{"evidence":"“It is very enjoyable in my opinion” and “it really helps me through tough times in life”","quality":"elaboration","description":"The essay adds more reflective commentary that expands the points beyond simple statements."}]}
